title: Morrow core contract version 1.1
$comment: Additions and declared replacements over urn:morrow:contracts:core:v1, which stays byte-identical. A definition resolves here first, then in v1 (docs/contracts/contract-versions.md). Replacements of v1 names are listed in changes.json.

HumanActorRef.description: A current human member acting in one workspace. Structurally an ActorRef with kind human, a workspace and a membership, and no installation or mandate.

KillSwitchControl.description: The control fields every kill switch carries (ADR-0005): a recorded reason and the agent proposal it executes, if any. A source proposal confers no authority; it is rechecked against the same tenant, capability and targets.

reason.description: Why the stop is needed. At least one non-whitespace character.

CampaignRef.description: One advertising campaign on one connection. The trusted tenant, store and connection are rechecked against the resolved record.

KillSwitchRecord.description: Append-only record of one executed kill switch, committed together with its effect. The owner notification is derived from it.

revision.description: Always 1: a record is never revised.

capabilityId.description: One of the five ADR-0005 kill switches.

NonNegativeDecimal.description: A non-negative decimal with at most 18 integer and 6 fractional digits.

NonNegativeMoney.description: A non-negative cash amount in one currency.

RiskClass.description: Review risk class. Derived by the server from the capability effect through the fixed table in docs/contracts/review-policy-defaults.json (ADR-0011 Q9).

SelectionIndexes.description: Zero-based target indexes of a partial approval. The review library also requires them strictly increasing, in range and a strict subset.

TargetSelection.description: Selected target indexes, or null for every target of the proposal.

ProposalTarget.description: One exact change target with its own credit and cash ceilings.

ProposalDerivation.description: Marks a proposal derived by partial approval from a root proposal; its id and digest are deterministic.

Proposal.description: Proposal@2. Replaces core v1 Proposal (changes.json); not compatible with it in either direction. taskId is null only for a human-made Governance-domain proposal (ADR-0018).

taskId.description: The work task the proposal belongs to. Null only for a human-made Governance-domain proposal (ADR-0018): when it is null this schema requires a governance.* capability and a HumanActorRef proposer, and checkProposal also checks the catalogue domain and that requestedBy is the proposer. Agents always name a task.

maximumCredits.description: The sum of the target credit ceilings (BigInt).

maximumCost.description: The exact sum of the target cash ceilings in one currency, or null when every target cost is null.

irreversible.description: Equals the catalogue value for the capability; server-derived.

reviewPolicyRef.description: The workspace's single current ReviewPolicy (storeId null).

requestedBy.description: The task initiator or mandate owner; the proposer when taskId is null (ADR-0018); server-derived.

beneficiaryPrincipalIds.description: Principals who benefit from the change, such as those receiving a grant, membership or ownership; server-derived.

contextTaint.description: Derived from the evidence the proposing run consumed.

proposalDigest.description: sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the proposal without this field.

ReviewRule.description: The review rule for one risk class.

requiredApprovals.description: Distinct eligible approvals that make a pending approval approved.

selfApproval.description: Whether a conflicted reviewer (proposer, requester or beneficiary) may approve: allowed; only a solo owner with the typed confirmation; or never.

pendingExpirySeconds.description: A pending approval expires this long after it is created.

approvedValiditySeconds.description: An approval may be dispatched for this long after it takes effect.

eligibleReviewerPrincipalIds.description: Principal IDs that may review this class, intersected with current grants; null applies no narrowing.

RestrictedReviewRule.description: A review rule for a class where self-approval is restricted (ADR-0005): never allowed.

requiredApprovals.description: Distinct eligible approvals that make a pending approval approved.

selfApproval.description: Whether a conflicted reviewer (proposer, requester or beneficiary) may approve: allowed; only a solo owner with the typed confirmation; or never.

pendingExpirySeconds.description: A pending approval expires this long after it is created.

approvedValiditySeconds.description: An approval may be dispatched for this long after it takes effect.

eligibleReviewerPrincipalIds.description: Principal IDs that may review this class, intersected with current grants; null applies no narrowing.

coolDownSeconds.description: A solo-owner approval takes effect this long after its decision.

quietPeriodSeconds.description: Solo status needs no membership change within this period.

ReviewPolicyRules.description: Rules per risk class plus the irreversible overlay, merged field by field taking the stricter value.

ReviewPolicy.description: The workspace review policy. A new revision makes approvals bound to the old one stale.

ApprovalDecision.description: One reviewer's recorded decision, idempotent per commandId.

soloOwnerConfirmation.description: Present only for a solo-owner approval: the digest of the typed phrase and the cool-down applied.

Approval.description: Approval@2. Replaces core v1 Approval (changes.json); not compatible with it in either direction.

reviewer.description: The reviewer whose decision closed the approval.

effectiveAt.description: When an approved approval may first dispatch; later than decidedAt only under a solo-owner cool-down.

ReviewDecisionInput.description: A reviewer's decision on one exact proposal digest.

expectedDecisionDigest.description: The digest of the proposal being decided: the parent, or the derived proposal for a selection.

soloOwnerConfirmation.description: The typed solo-owner confirmation phrase, compared exactly after NFC.

AccountOverview.description: GET /workspaces (P05.T01x, ADR-0009). The workspaces the signed-in person may enter now, filtered by current session eligibility in one snapshot, ordered by C collation of organization name and id, then workspace name and id; at most 100, with truncated set when more exist. onboarding is available only to a self-enrolled principal with no signup while signup is enabled for its profile. Selection is the URL /w/{workspaceId}; the server stores no active workspace.

organizationName.description: Display text only; render as text.

workspaceName.description: Display text only; render as text.

OrganizationSignupRequest.description: POST /organizations body (P05.T01x, ADR-0009): at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes of closed, duplicate-free JSON with a lowercase-UUID Idempotency-Key header. No client tenant, principal, subject or email field exists. Each name is 1-100 code points after NFC and trimming of the section 5 whitespace set W, with no code point of the control and bidirectional set F; the server applies that rule, this schema only bounds the length.

OrganizationSignupResult.description: POST /organizations result bodies (P05.T01x section 9): 201 created, 200 replayed, 400 invalid_name, 403 signup_unavailable, 409 already_onboarded or idempotency_conflict, 429 rate_limited with Retry-After: 600, and 503 outcome_unknown only after the create statement was submitted. A same-key retry is the reconciliation. 401 and other 503 replies use the fixed {code} body.

NullableId.description: An Id or null (a capability body field type; R11 needs a named type).

Boolean.description: A JSON boolean (a capability body field type).

StreamPosition.description: Opaque position, AEAD-sealed per viewer by the emitting service (P06.T02a, P07.T03). Never a decodable sequence number and never compared by clients.

PageCursor.description: Opaque page cursor, AEAD-sealed. Its decoded claims bind the principal, workspace, list kind, filter digest and issue time; another principal, workspace, list kind or filter, or an age over 24 hours, gives CURSOR_INVALID (400).

NullablePageCursor.description: The next page cursor, or null on the last page.

PageRequest.description: One page of at most 50 items after an opaque cursor, or the first page.

ConversationRef.description: Exact reference to one conversation revision.

MessageRef.description: Exact reference to one message revision.

ProjectRef.description: Exact reference to one project revision.

AccessRequestRef.description: Exact reference to one access request revision.

OperationRef.description: Exact reference to one operation revision.

KillSwitchRecordRef.description: Exact reference to one append-only KillSwitchRecord.

EventPayloadRef.description: Binds an event payload to its event: organizationId, workspaceId and storeId equal the envelope's, id is its eventId (validateCurrentDefinition checks both) and revision is always 1. digest is sha256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) payload, computed from the stored payload when the ref is built; it is not the outbox payload_digest, which hashes PostgreSQL jsonb text. A later fetch by ref resolves the tenant from the session, never from the ref.

TrustClass.description: Evidence trust class. The rank, least trusted first, is in docs/contracts/collaboration-defaults.json; P01.T02b may refine it.

CitedRef.description: The typed reference union a message part may cite (P01.T02a §9 C2). The four kind constants are distinct, so the union is discriminated by kind.

GrantVerb.description: One of the six grant verbs.

RestrictedSource.description: One view requirement: it maps 1:1 to a policy PermissionRequest {capabilityId, verb: view, resource, accountId, fields}. Sources are deduplicated by (capabilityId, resource, accountId) with fields merged; server-derived, never sent by a client.

RequestReason.description: A recorded reason: 1 to 1,024 characters, NUL-free, with at least one non-whitespace character.

ContextTaint.description: untrusted_external when any cited evidence or model-call context source is untrusted_external; server-derived.

ConversationSubject.description: What a conversation is about. One conversation per project and per task, lazily ensured by the first post. An Ask is private to ownerPrincipalId, the creating human (server-derived); workspace admins read it only through audited, read-only reads (ADR-0016 item 5).

ConversationSelector.description: Selects the conversation a post goes to.

Conversation.description: A conversation record. No status: conversations have no state machine. Positions are sealed per viewer, and posts never touch the revision or timestamps, so a hidden message leaves no signal.

revision.description: Always 1: no v1.1 command revises a conversation, and a post never changes it.

updatedAt.description: Equals createdAt; posts never change it.

lastPosition.description: The last position visible to this viewer, or null; viewer-relative.

MessageStatus.description: A human message is created completed. An agent message is created streaming by the runtime writer and ends completed, failed or cancelled; a lost lease ends it failed.

MentionTarget.description: A mention target: an active member or installation of the trusted workspace that can view the conversation subject now. Not a ref; it confers nothing.

MentionRequest.description: What the author asks of the target, under the author's own verbs: notify (an inbox item), task (a draft task, execute on workspace.task.create) or delegate (an agent child task in a task conversation, delegate on workspace.task.delegate). Never authority.

ArtifactPart.description: Cites one artifact revision. Adds view on workspace.artifact.read over the artifact plus the revision's recorded sources.

anchorRef.description: An anchor of the cited artifact revision, or null.

EvidenceSummaryPart.description: A summary over 1 to 50 cited evidence records. Evidence with a non-null sourceResource cannot be cited until Evidence@2 (P01.T02b) exists.

trustClass.description: The least-trusted cited evidence class; server-derived.

EvidenceSummaryPartInput.description: An evidence summary as a client sends it: the server derives trustClass.

MentionPart.description: A mention of one target: a human with notify or task, or an agent with delegate. Agent-authored messages carry no mention part.

MessagePart.description: One typed message part. text and mention parts add no view requirement.

MessagePartInput.description: A message part as a client sends it: evidence summaries carry no trustClass, which the server derives.

MessagePartInputs.description: 1 to 32 parts, at most 10 of them mentions; at most 64 KiB of JSON (server check).

MessageOrigin.description: Where an agent message comes from: a run in a project or task conversation (its task is the subject task or a task under the project's goal), or an Ask turn.

Message.description: A message. A viewer sees it only if they can view the conversation subject, hold view on workspace.conversation.post for the message fields and can view every restricted source (all-of); otherwise it is omitted from pages and counts.

position.description: Sealed per viewer; never a decodable sequence number.

author.description: A human (a HumanActorRef) or an agent naming its installation, with no membership; a service author is invalid.

parts.description: 0 to 32 parts (at least 1 once completed), at most 10 mentions.

replyToMessageId.description: A message in the same conversation; viewer-relative: null when the viewer cannot see it.

restrictedSources.description: Server-derived view requirements: the part requirements plus every model-call context source, deduplicated; at most 100 and 64 KiB of JSON. They only grow while streaming.

PostInput.description: A post. Restrictions, taint and trust class are server-derived, so a client cannot send them.

MessageDelta.description: A transient streaming delta, applied in sequence order. Deltas of a model call leave only after its context sources are committed and every subscriber is rechecked. A reconnect refetches the committed message and resumes at a sequence above the last seen.

StreamFrame.description: One stream frame. reset is the generic frame for a failed recheck, a resubscription or a policy-revision change; it says nothing more.

AskAdminReadAsk.description: One other member's Ask returned by an audited admin list page.

AskAdminReadRecord.description: The content-free audit record of one admin read of Asks (ADR-0016 item 5): one workspace list page, one conversation fetch or one message page. Committed in the read's transaction; content leaves only after that commit. A list record names every other member's Ask on the page in page order, each conversationId once, the reader's own left out; an empty page still gives one record. Never names the reader's own Ask (validateCurrentDefinition also checks that, and each conversationId once). Never contains message text. Retention: 365 days of content-free audit metadata.

InboxSubject.description: What an item is about; its kind equals InboxItem.kind. In a mention, conversationId and createdTaskId are viewer-relative.

StopProposalStatus.description: Derived, never stored, with precedence executed > dismissed > expired > open: executed when a KillSwitchRecord cites the proposal, dismissed when a dismissal exists, expired at expiresAt.

DecisionState.description: The decision state of an item's subject; the kind-to-machine map is fixed. Separate from read state: deciding never changes readState and marking never changes the decision.

ReadState.description: Per-recipient read state; never a decision.

InboxContext.description: Viewer-relative context: each id is null unless the viewer can view it now.

InboxItem.description: An inbox item, re-filtered at read time: returned only to its recipient, who holds view on workspace.inbox.read and can view the subject now. The owner's stop_notice is never target-filtered (ADR-0005).

recipientPrincipalId.description: The recipient, who is always the viewer.

open.description: From the fixed open-state table in docs/contracts/collaboration-defaults.json; the Inbox badge counts open items. A failed_operation exception and every informational item are never open.

InboxFilter.description: Inbox list filter; null means any. Every condition applies to the viewer-relative item: projectId matches only InboxItem.context.projectId as this viewer sees it, so a project the viewer cannot view gives the same empty page as an unknown id.

projectId.description: Matches the viewer-relative context.projectId; never the stored project of an item whose project the viewer cannot view.

InboxMarkInput.description: Marks the recipient's own items; an idempotent target state with no expectedRevision. Ids the viewer cannot see are omitted silently.

InboxItems.description: One page of at most 50 items.

ProjectTitle.description: A project title: 1 to 120 characters, NUL-free.

ProjectTabTitle.description: A project tab title: 1 to 60 characters, NUL-free.

ProjectTab.description: A tab showing the current revision of one artifact.

ProjectTabInputs.description: At most 20 tabs, in tab order; each artifactId must pass the reference rule for the writer.

Project.description: A project is a pinned Goal: a UX record over one goal, never a tenant or permission boundary. Read with goal view (view on workspace.goal.create).

pinRank.description: Viewer-relative dense rank among the pinned projects this viewer can view, from 0; null exactly when unpinned. Pins are workspace-wide, at most 20.

tabs.description: Viewer-relative: unviewable tabs are omitted; order is tab order.

AccessRequestScope.description: The authority a person asks for. Reachable only from the request input and the AccessRequest record; it never grants anything.

capabilityId.description: An existing capability that is not operator_* (server check).

AccessRequestContext.description: Where the request came from. Each id must pass the reference rule for the requester; viewer-relative on read.

AccessRequest.description: A human request for authority. Read by the requester and the deciders (eligible reviewers of the would-be governance.grants.revise proposal, never the requester). Only a linked, reviewed grant revision grants anything.

requester.description: Human only: agents have no access-request path in v1.1.

proposalRef.description: The linked governance.grants.revise proposal (P05.T02b), or null. After a partial approval it names the approved derived proposal.

decidedBy.description: The decider who denied, or the reviewer who rejected the linked proposal.

AccessRequestDecisionInput.description: A decider denies a pending request.

AccessRequestWithdrawInput.description: The requester withdraws their own pending request.

StopProposalDismissInput.description: Dismisses an open stop proposal (persisted by P11.T05). Needs execute on the proposal's kill-switch capability covering every target; an idempotent target state.

EmptyEventPayload.description: An event that carries no payload fields.

MessageCreatedPayload.description: message.created (P07.T03). Never message text; the relay reads mention rows, not the payload.

EventPayload.description: Any registered event payload: IDs and statuses only, at most 512 bytes of JCS. docs/contracts/event-registry.json binds each event type to exactly one of these, and validateEventPayload checks it.

EventEnvelope.description: EventEnvelope@2. Replaces core v1 EventEnvelope (changes.json): the v1 payloadRef is an ArtifactRef, and event payloads are not artifacts. validateCurrentDefinition also checks eventType, aggregateType and payload against the additive registry.

aggregateType.description: The registry's aggregate type for eventType.

streamPosition.description: Sealed per viewer; never the gap-free outbox position.

payload.description: The registered payload, or null for a viewer who cannot view every payload field (never a partial object).

payloadRef.description: Null exactly when payload is null, so a nulled payload leaves no digest to brute-force.
